items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jo was a real character, but I learned an awful lot from him.

ctx.x: Black band. There was no trouble with you playing with the black band?

No. In fact, [Harry] Sweets [Edison] used to call me Dusty Foot. He said, “You’re not Italian. You’re a Dusty Foot.” [? ?] “You’re Arapahoe.” Okay. Jo was a real character, but I learned an awful lot from him.
How old were you when you met him?
